scientific_scope: User-supplied workbook labelled RNZAF: 132 of 183 records contain coordinates, representing 59 distinct reported GPS positions; six records require an explicit paired hemisphere-suffix correction and 51 lack coordinates. Marker area indicates image count at an identical coordinate. Points are display context only—not image footprints, searched-area coverage, non-detection evidence, debris observations, or an estimator likelihood. Datum, timezone, altitude, camera geometry, search outcome, and dataset completeness are unspecified.
